tools.name: get_booking_page
tools.description: Read a public Yoya booking link or slug. Includes required guest fields and meeting options. No host account access.

tools.name: list_available_times
tools.description: Find up to 10 times (max 50), labeled in the guest's IANA timezone. Filter by inclusive from/exclusive to datetimes and morning (06–12), afternoon (12–18) or evening (18–24) in the guest timezone. Pass nextCursor unchanged to continue with the same filters. Slots are suggestions; preview then book r

tools.name: preview_booking
tools.description: Validate guest details and the selected time without booking or sending email. Show the returned summary to the guest and ask for explicit approval. Then call book_meeting with the returned normalized booking, requestId and confirmationToken.

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Creates a free booking or returns PAYMENT_REQUIRED with a secure payment URL for paid meetings. Paid meetings are not booked until payment succeeds; show the link and never claim confirmation before that. Only call after the guest explicitly approves preview_booking. Copy the preview's booking field

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Read a booking using its private manage-link token. Includes meeting-link synchronization status. Treat this token as a password; do not share it publicly.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel using a private manage token. Ask the guest for explicit approval first; this sends cancellation notifications.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Move a booking using its private manage token and a fresh slot ID from list_available_times. Ask for explicit approval first. The original booking stays intact if the new time cannot be reserved.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_booking" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read a booking using its private manage-link token. Includes meeting-link synchronization status. Treat this token as a password; do not share it publicly.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_booking_page" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up a public Yoya booking page. Pass its slug (the part after yoya.ai/) or the whole link — either works. Returns the host name, meeting title/description, meeting length, the meeting options offered (google_meet / zoom / in_person), and any fields the guest must provide to book. Returns null if" → after: "Read a public Yoya booking link or slug. Includes required guest fields and meeting options. No host account access."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
